requires.degrade: Without node, /prototype:explore-directions and /prototype:pressure-test cannot run the medium resolver: each says so in one line and keeps its shipped default, and pressure-test's audience routing still picks the shell. Without node, explore-directions also cannot write a note's relocation script, so it reads the mockup file to say whether a note's element is still there.
Without Python 3, /prototype:explore-directions cannot serve the mockup's notes host, so notes stay in the page's copy-out control and the file:// mockup works as before.
Without curl, the notes host's session watcher does not start, so notes stay in the page's copy-out control and the file:// mockup works as before.

Without playwright-cli, /prototype:explore-directions cannot run a note's relocation script, so it takes no screenshot of the noted element and reads the mockup file to say whether the element is still there.
